# Trace fixture

`web-dev-with-commit.json.gz` is copied unchanged from
[chrome-devtools-mcp](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/blob/2ab93a3/tests/trace-processing/fixtures/web-dev-with-commit.json.gz),
